## Experiment

```{r}
library(ggmosaic2)

hair_freq <- as.data.frame(HairEyeColor)

{hair_freq |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_mosaic(aes(weight = Freq, 
                  x = product(Hair, Eye))) +
  scale_fill_residual() +
  mosaic_settings(expected = "independence") +
  geom_mosaic_text(display_values = "residual",
                   format_digits = 1,
                   size = 3.5,
                   colour = "black") +
  labs(title = "Hair × Eye Independence Model with Residual Values",
       subtitle = "Numbers show Pearson residuals")} |> 
  codehover::ch_hover()


data(titanic)

ggplot(titanic, aes(x = product(Class, Sex))) +
  mosaic_settings(
    expected = "conditional",
    offset = 0.005
  ) +
  geom_mosaic() +
  geom_mosaic_text(display_values = "residual") +
  scale_fill_residual() +
  theme_mosaic()


ggplot(data = titanic, aes(x = product(Class))) +
  geom_mosaic() +
  aes(fill = Survived) +
  scale_fill_residual() 

# ggplot(data = titanic, aes(x = product(Survived, Class))) +

```

```{r, eval = F}

library(ggplot2)
data.frame(my_x = rnorm(2000),  
           my_y = rnorm(2000)) |> 
  ggplot() +  
  aes(x = my_x) +  
  aes(y = my_y) +  
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity() 

ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity

data.frame(my_x = rnorm(2000),  
           my_y = rnorm(2000)) |> 
  ggplot() +  
  aes(x = my_x) +  
  ggforce::geom_autohistogram()


 # Diagonal histograms

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mpg) +
  ggforce::geom_autopoint() + 
  ggforce::facet_matrix(vars(drv:fl), layer.diag = 2, grid.y.diag = FALSE) +
  ggforce::geom_autohistogram()


ggforce::geom_autohistogram
```
